AI Knowledge Platform — Sample Document

The AI Knowledge Platform lets users create private knowledge bases for their documents.
Each knowledge base belongs to exactly one authenticated user.

Supported documents in the MVP include plain text, Markdown, PDF, and DOCX files.
Uploaded files are processed in memory. The backend extracts text, normalizes it,
splits it into overlapping chunks, and stores the document metadata and chunks in
PostgreSQL. Original files are not stored permanently in the first version.

The first chunking configuration uses a chunk size of 1000 characters and an overlap
of 150 characters. Embeddings and vector search will be added in a later stage.
